(i) Non-normal returns: by (4) with u_2 = rho u_1 + sqrt(1-rho^2) w, equal SR and w standard normal independent of u_1 (kappa_21 = rho gamma_3, kappa_12 = rho^2 gamma_3, kappa_22 - 1 = rho^2 (gamma_4 - 1)): theta - (V_1+V_2) = rho [ -2 + SR gamma_3 (1 + rho) - (1/2) SR^2 rho (gamma_4 - 1) ]. Numerical check (scratchpad prop54_counter.py, exact enumeration of a two-point u_1 against 80-point Gauss-Hermite for w): u_1 a standardized Bernoulli(0.03576) (gamma_3 = 5, gamma_4 = 26, a legal pair since 26 = 1 + 5^2), SR_1 = SR_2 = 0.5, rho = 0.1 gives exact theta = 1.22889 > V_1 + V_2 = 1.18514 (difference +0.04375, equal to the formula), so with positive correlation the naive test is oversized, not undersized (rho = 0.2: +0.0750). (ii) Units: for normal returns with SR^2 > 2 (SR = 2) and rho = -0.9, (V_1+V_2) - theta = rho (2 + SR^2 rho) = +1.44 > 0, so negative correlation gives an undersized test; the sign rule needs SR^2 < 2 per period.
